release.content: pg-backup 0.2.1 was released on 2026-11-08 from commit 509ef3c5dbe4abcdf46c8fa45a8bae06cd2bc9d9 with these changes.

rows: pg-backup --version prints the installed release's version (0.2.0 said 0.1.0), and consumer/pg-backup pins the release it ships in

the pg.database need type for pubkit's deploy walk (entry point sustenaut.needs): its check reads the settings, the StatefulSet, the wal-g sidecar's status lines and the WAL Secret; its fulfil makes the archive's keys as setup-secrets does, through the walk's Bitwarden writer, with the WAL Secret on kubectl's input
